title: 第002章 小延军拜师第003章 秦雨水下山
content_zh:
;;
翌日清晨。
燕京。
秦氏山庄。
柳嫣然别墅内。
秦霸天看着眼前的一切，愤怒的问道。
“你们谁能告诉我，这是怎么回事？飞雄失踪，嫣然和我的大孙子都去了哪里？”
一旁的老二秦飞扬，老三秦飞明，站在一旁默不作声。
老二秦飞扬眼角划过一丝淡淡的得意之色，这个表情并没有人注意到。
秦霸天再次发话，“管家，给我查，这到底是怎么回事？发动家族所有资源寻找柳嫣然和我的大孙子，这里把它收拾出来，保持原样，谁也不能动，谁也不能占用。否则，家规处置，然后赶出家族。”
“是，老爷，我这就去安排。”老管家秦伯说完便离开了。
而此时，乞丐驻地的山巅一处洞府之中。
“妈妈，妈妈，我要妈妈！”
“小少爷，家里出事了，你是个男子汉，要坚强起来。等你长大了，好为家里报仇。”秦雨水说着，眼泪哗哗的往下流，眼神中闪过一抹杀意。
“水叔叔，我妈妈呢？她怎么了？我要妈妈！”
“小主，我会想办法去找你妈妈，现在我有个事情要跟你说。”
“水叔叔，你说。”
“昨晚我们被追杀，是一名老神仙救了我们。老神仙很厉害，你愿意拜他为师吗？”
“水叔叔，真的吗？我们被老神仙救了吗？那我愿意拜他为师，等到我成了神仙就可以去救妈妈了！”
小小的秦延军回忆起了昨晚妈妈在危机之中的呼喊声。

秦雨水松了一口气，还好，小主人虽然年纪小，但是很明白事理。
主洞府之中，正中间挂着一幅乞丐画像，虽然是乞丐，但是神采奕奕，穿着乞丐服，腰间挂着酒葫芦，两眼炯炯有神。
此时，老乞丐正在给画像之中的乞丐上着香。
“祖师爷在上，第一百六十八代弟子今日招收一名关门弟子秦延军，请祖师爷保佑平安，让他今后为丐帮发扬光大。保护天下的黎民百姓，今日将此重任传授与他……！”老乞丐嘴中念念有词。
随后转过身来，看着小小的秦延军，满脸的慈祥，但是严厉的说道：“秦延军，今日收你为我的关门弟子，望你以后能够将丐帮发扬光大，善待天下的黎民百姓。”
“师傅在上，请受徒儿一拜。”
小小的秦延军像模像样的，拜了三拜。
一旁的秦雨水双手抱拳，“恭喜恭喜，恭喜神丐喜得关门弟子。”
“哈哈哈哈哈。”
“今日招收关门弟子，我很开心，所以接下来我们好好的喝一盅。”
老乞丐满脸高兴，又道：“徒儿，今日我便教你入门修炼。”

The next morning.
Yanjing.
Qin's Villa.
Inside Liu Yanran's villa.
Qin Batian looked at everything in front of him and asked angrily.
"Can any of you tell me what's going on? Feixiong is missing, and where are Yanran and my eldest grandson?"
The second oldest, Qin Feiyang, and the third oldest, Qin Feiming, stood aside silently.
A faint look of pride flashed across the corner of Qin Feiyang's eyes, but no one noticed this expression.
Qin Batian spoke again, "Steward, check for me, what is going on? Use all the resources of the family to find Liu Yanran and my eldest grandson. Take it out here and keep it as it is. No one can move it and no one can occupy it. Otherwise, we will deal with it according to the family rules and then drive it out of the family."
"Yes, sir, I'll make arrangements right away." Uncle Qin, the old butler, left after saying this.
At this time, there was a cave on the top of the mountain where the beggar was stationed.
"Mom, mom, I want mom!"
"Young master, something happened at home. You are a man, so be strong. When you grow up, you can avenge your family." Qin Yuyu said, tears streaming down his face, and a murderous intent flashed in his eyes.
"Uncle Shui, where is my mother? What happened to her? I want my mother!"
"Little Master, I will find a way to find your mother. Now I have something to tell you."
"Uncle Shui, tell me."
"We were hunted last night, but an old immortal saved us. The old immortal is very powerful. Are you willing to become your disciple?"
"Uncle Shui, is it true? Have we been saved by the old god? Then I am willing to worship him as my teacher. When I become a god, I can save my mother!"
Little Qin Yanjun recalled his mother's cry in crisis last night.
Qin Yuyu breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, although the little master is young, he understands things very well.
In the main cave, there is a portrait of a beggar hanging in the middle. Although he is a beggar, he is full of energy, wearing beggar clothes, with a wine gourd hanging around his waist, and his eyes are bright.
At this time, the old beggar was offering incense to the beggar in the portrait.
"My lord, the 168th generation of disciples today recruits Qin Yanjun, a closed disciple. Please bless me and keep him safe so that he can prosper for the Beggar Clan in the future. Protect the people of the world, and I will teach him this important task today...!" The old beggar muttered something.
Then he turned around and looked at the little Qin Yanjun, with a kind face, but said sternly: "Qin Yanjun, today I accept you as my close disciple. I hope you can carry forward the Beggar Clan and be kind to the people of the world."
"Master, please bow to me, my disciple."
The little Qin Yanjun looked decent and bowed three times.
Qin Yuyu on the side clasped his fists, "Congratulations, congratulations to God Beggar for closing his discipleship."
"Hahahahaha."
"I'm very happy to recruit closed disciples today, so let's have a good drink next."
The old beggar's face was full of joy and he said again: "Disciple, today I will teach you how to start practicing."
